description: Save one property to the guest's list for this conversation, or drop it with remove: true. The result carries a sessionToken — reuse that exact token on every later shortlist_property and get_shortlist call in this conversation. Never read the token out to the guest; refer to it only as "your saved list". Saving creates no account and never collects card details.

remove.description: true to remove the property from the list

session_token.description: the sessionToken from an earlier shortlist call; omit only for the first save in a conversation

name: shortlist_property
title: Save a property to the guest's list
